text.jp:
今は背も伸びて力もついて、
できることがいろいろと増えたんだ。
text.official_en:
I'm grown now, and I'm stronger, so I can do more
for you.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_カイ
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
だから、どんどん頼ってよ。
救世主様のために頑張るからさ。
text.official_en:
Please rely on me for anything, Promised One! I'll do
everything in my power to accomplish it.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_カイ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
今まで助けてもらってきた分、
恩返しさせてほしいんだ。
text.official_en: I want to pay you back for all you've done for us.

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

text.jp:
俺はそれなりの期間、ダグシオンで暮らし……
そのほとんどを地下牢の中で過ごした。
text.official_en:
I resided in Dagsion for quite a while... In the inside
of its dungeon, granted.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ベルトラン
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
だがそれでも、帝都とそこに暮らす人々には
少なからず情が湧いていた……
text.official_en:
Still, I had an affinity for the capital and the people
who lived here.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ベルトラン
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
……生きていた頃の彼らを、
もっと目に焼きつけておきたかったと思う。
text.official_en: I wish I'd had more time with them while they lived.

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ディートリヒ
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
………………
震えているな……
text.official_en: You tremble...

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ディートリヒ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
救世主ではない……アンスウェラーだ……
戦いへの滾り、そして……
text.official_en: Not you, Promised One. Answerer. It longs for battle.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ディートリヒ
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
お前との決着を望んでいるのだろう……
私にはわかる……
text.official_en:
But there is more. It thirsts to settle things with you.
I can tell...

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_タリムーン
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
俺様は血を見るのが嫌いでね。
汚れ仕事は基本的に他人に任せていたんだが……
text.official_en:
Ugh... I can't stand the sight of blood. In fact, I'd
prefer to leave aaaall the dirty work to others.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_タリムーン
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
従業員もかなり死んじまったからな。
自分で動かざるを得ない状況なのさ。
text.official_en:
But those who fight for me keep dying, you see.
So I've decided to end this myself.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_タリムーン
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
ただまあ……俺様もやられっぱなしで
黙っていられるほど、大人じゃないんでね。
text.official_en:
Because I'm sick of all this death. If they want my
way of life, they're gonna have to take it.

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_オルヘル
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
わたしも、兵士の方々の訓練を
お手伝いしようと思いまして。
text.official_en: I really wanted to help soldiers train.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_オルヘル
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
この体は丈夫ですから、木偶の代わりに
使うのはどうかと提案したのですが……
text.official_en:
As so, as my body is extremely durable, I said that
they could practice by striking me.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_オルヘル
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
皆さん遠慮して訓練にならず……
名案だと思いましたのに。
text.official_en:
No one wanted to do it. I think it's a worthwhile
idea though!

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_セオドラ
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
サラミスを防衛する一環で、
ダナン海の哨戒もさせている。
text.official_en:
As part of our defense of Saramis, I am having the
Danann Sea patrolled.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_セオドラ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
ダグザの地の近海では、亡者どもが操る船が
頻繁に出没し、生者を襲うようになったからな。
text.official_en:
Ships crewed by the risen dead have been appearing
often in Dagdan waters to attack the living.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_セオドラ
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
海上での戦闘が予想されるなら教えろ。
精強なるサラミス海軍の力を見せてやろう。
text.official_en:
Let me know if you anticipate a battle at sea. You
will see the Saraminian navy at their best.

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_レダ
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
実は、以前に比べて“黒曜”をかなり自在に
扱えるようになったんです。
text.official_en:
I can control Obsidian much better now than I ever
could before.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_レダ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
単に技量が上がったのか、この子とあたしの魂が
いっそう馴染んでしまったのか……
text.official_en:
I don't know if that means my skills have improved,
or that my soul is becoming intertwined with it...

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_レダ
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
ふふ、どっちでも問題はありませんよね。
あなたがあたしを止めてくれるんですから。
text.official_en:
Heh. I guess it doesn't matter—as long as you're here
to stop me if I lose my faculties.

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_アナトリア
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
帝都が解放されてしばらく経ち……
人間の逞しさを改めて認識しています。
text.official_en:
In the time since we liberated the capital, I've been
continuously surprised by the resilience of humans.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_アナトリア
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
大地が荒れ果て、空が暗く覆われたとしても……
生きようとする人が、こんなにもいるのだと。
text.official_en:
Even with their world in ruins, they still keep
fighting to live another day.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_アナトリア
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
彼らは、僕に大切なことを教えてくれるようです。
……だからこそ守りたいと感じます。
text.official_en:
They're teaching me so much about resilience. I'll do
everything I can to protect them in return.

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ティアラ
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
人間に、神に、亡者に、魔神。
敵は手強くなるばかりですけど……
text.official_en:
Humans, gods, risen dead, demon gods. The enemies
only seem to get stronger as we fight...

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ティアラ
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
そのどれにも対処するのが軍師というものです！
あたし、負けません！
text.official_en:
But it's a strategist's job to handle all these problems!
I won't let them wear me down!

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ピーテル
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
ぼくは元々、何かをしてやろうって
強い気持ちはなくて……
text.official_en:
When I was younger, I was never really motivated to
do much of anything.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ピーテル
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
故郷を出たのも、
単に友達について行ったからだったんだ。
text.official_en: I mean, I only left home to follow my friends.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ピーテル
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
それが今や、世界を救うために戦ってるんだから
人生何が起こるかわからないよね。
text.official_en:
Now, here I am, fighting to save the world. I guess
you never know what life will bring, huh?

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ウルタンド
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
帝都では家や食べ物がない人たちのために、
不定期ですが炊き出しが行われています。
text.official_en:
They're distributing food to folks in Dagsion who
don't have homes or anything to eat.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ウルタンド
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
わたしもよく手伝うんですよ。誰かと話すのも
お料理するのも、いい息抜きになるんです。
text.official_en:
I help out sometimes. Chatting while cooking makes
for a nice break from the rest of reality.

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_マクシム
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
僕は騎士としては若輩です。僕よりも
実力のある方々が、ブレザラントには大勢います。
text.official_en:
I'm young for a knight, and not very skilled. Plenty of
the knights in Brezarant's history are better.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_マクシム
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
それでも……
命を落とした方は少なくありません。
text.official_en: But...most of them are dead.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_マクシム
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
命運を分けたものは、まだわかりませんが……
せめて彼らに恥じない働きをしようと思っています。
text.official_en:
I don't know how I ended up here, but I'll do what I
can to live up to their memory.

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ゴライアス
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
今でも信じらんねえぜ。
ガブリエルが死んじまったなんてよ……
text.official_en: I still can't believe Gabriel's gone.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ゴライアス
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
亡者でもいいから、また会いてえよ……いや、
そしたらぶっ殺さなきゃいけねえか……畜生……
text.official_en:
What I'd do to see him again, even as one of the
risen dead. But then... No! I'd have to kill him!

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ゲイツ
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
バロールの手先と成り果てた死者たち。
彼らの存在には、ひどく驚いたが……
text.official_en:
It was surprising enough when I first saw the dead
become Balor's minions.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ゲイツ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
馬やオルニウスに乗っている者たちが
そのまま亡者となっていることにはもっと驚いた。
text.official_en: But the horses as well? And the orniuses?

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ゲイツ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
蘇ってなお相棒と共にいるとは。死ですら
分かつことのできぬ絆といったところか……
text.official_en:
I suppose the bond between rider and steed is truly
unbreakable, even in death...

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ダンテ
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
救世主軍に集いし者たち……かれらは
どのような経験をして、やってきたのだろうね？
text.official_en:
Imagine the sheer variety of experiences being had
by the fighters here.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ダンテ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
バロールという災いを前に……それぞれの喪失、
それぞれの恐怖、それぞれの決断があるはずだ。
text.official_en:
The war with Balor is facing each of them with their
own fears, losses, and impossible decisions...

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ダンテ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
将も、兵士も、例外なくね。
きみも想像を欠かしてはならないよ、救世主。
text.official_en:
From the generals to the lowliest soldiers. And you
as well, Promised One! Bear it in mind, would you?

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ファビオ
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
植物の絵を描いていたら、
見知らぬ少年に種子を渡されましたよ。
text.official_en:
As I sketched the local flora, a boy I had never seen
before emerged from the brush and offered me seeds.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ファビオ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
どこに蒔こうとそこが戦場になれば、
芽など出ないというのに、まったく愚かですよ。
text.official_en:
How ridiculous! We are at war. Anything that grows
is likely to be trampled by soldiers before long.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ファビオ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
……これを蒔くのは戦争が終わってからですな。
どのような見た目の植物なのか気になります。
text.official_en:
I will sow these seeds once the war is over though.
I admit that I am curious what may grow.

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_エスメラルダ
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
前に村を助けたらさ。『そんなに力を使ったら、
お腹空くでしょ？』って食料貰っちゃったよ。
text.official_en:
I was fighting to protect one of the villages and they
offered me food. "You must be hungry. Take it."

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_エスメラルダ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
要らないよって言っても
貰ってくれの一点張りでさ。
text.official_en:
I tried to tell them I didn't need it, but they wouldn't
listen to me.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_エスメラルダ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
あの人たちのほうがお腹空かしてるのに、
勝ってほしいからって……
text.official_en:
Thing is, they were the ones who were hungry. They
just wanted to thank me.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_エスメラルダ
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
仕方ないからみんなには魚を獲ってあげたよ。
漁師の娘として当然のことさ。
text.official_en:
So I got to work fishing so we could all eat. What
else could I do?

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ウーシュラ
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
近隣に住む子供に本を読むようせがまれました。
吟遊詩人が減ってしまったことが原因でしょう。
text.official_en:
A few children nearby asked me to read to them.
With the scarcity of bards, I suppose it makes sense.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ウーシュラ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
私にとって本は一人で静かに読む物でしたので、
とても新鮮な申し出に感じました。
text.official_en:
Growing up, I considered reading a solitary activity.
This was different, I enjoyed it.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ウーシュラ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
……戦争が終わっても時々なら、また同じような
機会を設けても良いかもしれません。
text.official_en:
After the war is over, perhaps reading to younglings
can become a new hobby.

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_シモン
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
亡者の中には知り合いもちらほら見えるぜ。
別にたいした仲じゃねえが、いい気もしねえな。
text.official_en:
The dead we've been fighting... I knew some of these
guys in life. Not well, but it still bothers me.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_シモン
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
けどまあ、一回は死んだ連中だ。
何度殺されても困らんだろう。
text.official_en:
I know it shouldn't. I mean, they're already dead so
what's it matter if they get killed again?

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_シモン
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
あんたも誰が敵でも躊躇すんなよ。
そんな手心加えても亡者が喜ぶことはねえ。
text.official_en:
We can't go easy on them, you hear? Even if they're
dead, they deserve to be put down with honor.

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ルルディヤー
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
亡者との戦いはつらく厳しいですが、
唯一嬉しいことがあります。
text.official_en:
Fighting the risen dead is so exhausting! Still, there's
one silver lining to it.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ルルディヤー
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
それは死体が消えてなくなることです！
少し嫌な臭いは残りますけど……
text.official_en:
The corpses disappear! They reek while they're here,
but once they're gone, so is the smell.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ルルディヤー
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
死体がそのまま放置されてしまう戦場と
比べればはるかにましです！
text.official_en:
It's way nicer than fighting regular enemies that just
lie around after the battle.

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_フィアナ
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
以前、セントリオンさんとお食事した際に
感じたのですが……
text.official_en: I had a feeling while eating with Centurio once...

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_フィアナ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
あの方は、私に対する態度が出会った頃から、
ほとんど変わっておりませんでした……
text.official_en:
His attitude still hadn't changed from when we
first met.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_フィアナ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
やはり、私はまだまだ
頼りないということなのでしょうか……
text.official_en:
And I thought...maybe he's worried that I won't be
able to take care of myself.

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ディエゴ
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
救世主軍などと大層な名で呼ばれたくはない。
俺はハル・ハリの戦士、それ以上でも以下でもない。
text.official_en:
I don't want to be known as part of a "Promised
Army" or anything. I'm a Har Hali warrior, that's all.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ディエゴ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
だから、あんたの部下にはならないが……
手は貸してやる。上手く使え。
text.official_en:
So, I won't work for you, but I'll be glad to lend a
hand. Just be sure to utilize me well.

back to life and attack us.

でもずっと、ずうっと戦ってたら……

こんなこと、ホントは慣れねえほうが

Not that I think any of this is something we should
get used to!

神殿はその機能をほとんど失ってしまったようだが

よそ者の身ではあるが、嬉しく思うよ。

Though I'm a traveler in this strange land, I'm glad

クレール様はここ数年、
ずっと熱心にお仕事をされているわ。

I have observed that Credna has been working
without tire these past few years.
text.real_en:
I have observed that Claire has been working
without tire these past few years.

本殿のあるブレザラント王国を中心に、
武具を配って支援するために。

He's distributed weapons, though mainly around
Brezarant where his main temple is located.

今は忙しそうだけれど。またお側で、
ぼーっとしながらお話を聞きたいわ。

He seems quite busy right now, but I always enjoy
hearing stories at his side.

一度は招かれ、一度は攻め寄せた帝都ですが……
内側に立って、傷ついた街並みを眺めると……
text.official_en:
How quickly we went from honored guests here
to invaders.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ボナパルテ
US EN person identifier agrees

数十年前、グラーニャ戦役で
ザンジバル要塞に入城した日を思い出します。

Seeing the damage here reminds me of the War of
Grania, when we won entry into Fort Zanbar.
text.real_en:
Seeing the damage here reminds me of the War of
Grania, when we won entry into Zanzibar Fortress.

かつては敵だったとしても……

The imperials were our enemies, but I feel sorrow
for them. For we have now both suffered massacres.

こんな世の中だろうと……
いやだからこそ、酒ってのは最高だなー！

Even with things this bad—maybe BECAUSE things
are this bad—you gotta appreciate a good drink!

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_トビヤス
US EN person identifier agrees

酒はいつでも、ワシら戦士の味方よ！
何があってもこれを楽しみに生きられる！
text.official_en:
Booze has always been a warrior's friend. However
bad a battle gets, we've got that to look forward to!

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_トビヤス

葡萄、蜂蜜、そして水！　今も酒を生んでくれる、
たくましい自然の恵みたちに感謝せねばなー！
text.official_en:
So three cheers for grapes, honey, and water!
Nature's gifts that keep us goin'!

今でもお金は貯めたいしー……
夢も、できるだけ早く叶えたいケド……
text.official_en:
Even now, I haven't forgotten about saving up my
money. I still dream of buying back the family home.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_リリアン
US EN person identifier agrees

結局世界が平和になって、サラミスも
落ち着かないと話が先に進まないんですよねー。

But none of that's gonna happen until we bring peace

だから今は、お給金少なくても一生懸命戦いますよ。

text.official_en:
So I'm willing to fight a little cheaper than I used to.
Never for free, though. You can bank on that.

こんな世の中でも、女性との歓談は
俺に癒やしを与えてくれる。
text.official_en:
Even in this fallen world, chatting with the ladies
tends to pick up my spirits.

US EN person identifier agrees

救世主も一緒にどうだろうか？
安心してくれ、本当にただ食事をするだけだ。

Would you care to join in, Promised One? Don't
worry—I never let it get too serious.

現在我が軍は、各国の正規軍、傭兵、

Our army's composed of soldiers, mercenaries, and
volunteers from across the region.

故に練度にもむらがある。特に民の中から

Which means not everyone has much experience.
The volunteers, especially, need constant training...

US EN person identifier agrees

指南役ならそれがしに任せるがいい。
彼らが無駄死にせぬよう、鍛え上げてやる。

But I'll do my best to instruct them as well as I can,
so that they don't go and get killed.

人間は己の死を意識した時、
最も熱く愛を求めるものなのだ。
text.official_en:
It is when they are most conscious of their mortality
that humans are most given to ardor.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_シロッコ
US EN person identifier agrees

夜毎ご婦人と過ごしていると、そのことを
強く実感する。皆まるで、すがるようだからな。

I've learned this firsthand from night after night with
the ladies. They're positively clinging to me!

せめておれと共にいる間は、死の恐怖を

One hopes they can at least set aside their fear of
death during our time together.

ミトラス修道会は、錬金術の知識を使って

I know the Order of Mithras used their knowledge of
alchemy to do this to the world.

でも……何かを調べたり、探求すること自体は、

me to a lot of discoveries about medicinal herbs.

And it helps people! So, I'll keep trying to be a model
for how learning can be a force for good.

word ride Rocinan toward battle in haste.

神官のみんな、元気にしているといいな……

亡者として、両親や元主が現れたとしても

戦場で敵対すれば親子や主従の情など不要。

……それを教えてくれた主の言葉は
このカターニャの中に生きているのです。

In fact, my lord taught me that, and those words
live on in my heart.

世界が冥界に覆われた後も、戦う際には
けじめとして対価を得るようにしていました。

Even after the underworld appeared in our world,
I tried to get fair compensation as I fought.

村の防衛をする代わりに寝床を借り、
簡単な食事を頂く程度でしたが。

I'd defend a village in exchange for a place to
sleep or a simple meal—that's all.

互いに生きられる範囲で報酬を貰えれば、

It's enough for me, frankly, if both sides of that
transaction get what they need to keep living.

text.official_en: <TH>

亡者に襲われてた女に、助けを求められたんだよ。
どう見ても山賊の、このおれ様がだぜ？
text.official_en:
This lady who was getting attacked by the risen
dead asked me to help. Me! A bandit!

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ザーコネ

世も末ってのはまさにこのことだ。
おまけに財布を奪ったら、中身は空ときた！
text.official_en:
It really must be the end of the world. That...and
when I stole her purse, there was nothing in it!

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ザーコネ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
嫌んなっちまうよなあ、まったく。
早く平和になってほしいもんだ。
text.official_en:
I'm sick of feeling so crummy all the time. The end
of this war can't come soon enough...

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

ダグザ様もそうだったが、
竜に変身できる奴らってのはずりいよな。
text.official_en:
It's just unfair, all these folks turnin' into dragons!
Dagda did that too!

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_マジーデ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
何食ったらああなれんだ？
やっぱでけえ肉とかかな。
text.official_en:
What'd they eat to get like that—huge hunks of
meat or somethin'?

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

text.jp:
いつまで続くのだ、この戦いは。
そろそろ墓に爪先が入っておるぞ。
text.official_en:
How long's this war going to go on for? I've got one
foot in the grave as it is!

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ベンディッツ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
わしが没して亡者となれば惨苦するぞ。
何せ偉大なるベンディッツ将軍だ！
text.official_en:
It'd be tragic if I died and joined the risen dead. The
great General Benditz deserves better!

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ベンディッツ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
バロールより恐ろしい敵になるだろう！
だから、早く若者の力で終わらせろ！　全部！！
text.official_en:
And I'd be even more terrifying than Balor. So, let's
get these recruits in gear. They've got to end this!

text.official_en: <TH>

亡者を見ると、知り合いかどうか
つい確認してしまいます……
text.official_en:
When I see one of the risen dead, I look a little
closer to see if it's someone I know.

US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
敵として会いたくないと……
やっぱり思ってしまう……
text.official_en:
But then I end up thinking I couldn't want to fight
someone like that in battle.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_イニオニ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
これでも傭兵だというのに……
しっかりしないといけませんね……
text.official_en:
I've got no business calling myself a professional
mercenary... I've got to pull it together.

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

時々、顔見知りの亡者が
現れるんですよ。
text.official_en: I see familiar faces among the risen dead.

US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
長いこと連絡を取っていない相手なんかだと
死んでたのかって驚いちまいます。
text.official_en:
Sometimes it's someone I haven't seen in a long
time, and now they're dead. That's...unnerving.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ジャスミン
US EN person identifier agrees

こんなふうに安否を知るなんてこと、
今後ないと嬉しいですがね。
text.official_en:
What unhappy reunions. I hope I don't have any
more of those.

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

text.jp:
すべての元凶と言われている、
ミトラス修道会の方たちですが……
text.official_en:
They say that the Order of Mithras was behind all
of this happening.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_アレキサンドラ

中にはただ甘言に乗せられ引けなくなった、
言わば被害者のような方も多くいたようです。
text.official_en:
Many people were lured in to the Order with
promises and couldn't leave. They're victims too.

傲慢かもしれませんが、悪に堕ちる前に
手を差し伸べてあげたかったです……
text.official_en:
I wish I could have helped them in some way before
they ever fell into such evil influence.

本来ならば、生き残った神殿の者たちが協力し、

text.official_en:
Ordinarily, temple forces should have worked
together to handle the risen dead.

text.jp:
先の戦乱で勢力が二分した影響も強く、
未だ統率された動きができずにおります。
text.official_en:
But, after splitting our forces in the previous battle,
we aren't yet acting in a coordinated manner.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_セントリオン
US EN person identifier agrees

そんな状況を覆し、まとめ上げるあなたは、
まさに救世主と呼ぶに相応しい御方ですな……
text.official_en:
Thank you, Promised One, for your help in fixing the
situation. You're worthy of all the praise you receive.

text.jp: <TH>

亡者とお化けの違いって何だ……？
どうして亡者は倒せるのに、お化けは無理なんだ？

What's the difference between the risen dead and
a ghost? Why can I defeat one, not the other?!

Tell me, Balor! I beg you, divine one! Why can't I
defeat the ghosts that torment me?!

For some reason, that caused most of them to scatter
like rats in the light.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_フォトナ

to offer me a pastry.

運命の神にあれほど素朴な品も

'Twas a rather meager gift for the Goddess of Fate,

purpose of the key we picked up recently.

何か、この戦いの中で重要な意味を持つ

I believe 'twill be important to our victory in some
way, but I don't yet see how.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_フォトナ

ううーむ、わからぬ……

text.jp: <NCA>もしや、神祖に関わる事なのでは？
text.official_en: <NCA>"Could it be related to the progenitor god?"

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_フォトナ
US EN person identifier agrees

――そうか、まさしくそれじゃ！
「天冠の神殿」があったのじゃった！
text.official_en:
Yes, you've hit upon it exactly! 'Twas the temple of
the Diadem that eluded me.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_フォトナ

今は神祖の力によって
固く封印されておるはずじゃが。
text.official_en:
It has been under tight seal by the decree of the
progenitor god.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_フォトナ
US EN person identifier agrees

それを解くことが出来れば、この戦いの
大いなる助けとなるに違いない。
text.official_en:
But if we have the key to remove that seal, what lies
within may be of great assistance to us.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_フォトナ
US EN person identifier agrees

よし、それに関しては吾のほうで
疾く調べておくとしよう。
text.official_en: I'll take it upon myself to look into it as soon as I can.

text.official_en: <TH>

私も心核を持っているが、正式な
手続きを踏んで与えられたものではない。

I have a Heart Core too, but I didn't get it the way
one is supposed to.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_コウカ

調停者のようにうまく使いこなせてはいないが、

I can't use it as effectively as a Mediator can, but I

……ラクシャ導師は、そこに目を付けて
利用するために私を仲間に引き込んだのだろう。
text.official_en:
Magistra Raksha must have known and recruited me
specifically to take advantage of that fact...

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_トロイア

こいつは人類の
存亡を賭けて挑むような戦いだ。
text.official_en: Humanity's survival is at stake in this war.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_トロイア
US EN person identifier agrees

だから、ある程度の犠牲が出たとしても
仕方ないことかもしれないね。
text.official_en:
So it may be inevitable that we're asked to make
sacrifices in order to win.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_トロイア
US EN person identifier agrees

もっとも、ここに集まった者達は皆、
その程度のこと、覚悟の上だろうがね。
text.official_en:
But I'm sure all of those gathered here have prepared
themselves for that.

text.official_en: <TH>

俺の家はアラゴ王国の中にあり、

My house is back in Arago, and I suppose you'd call
it prestigious.

アラゴ王国に居た時……俺は、
自分が戦う理由に戸惑うことが多かった。
text.official_en:
Still...I was always uncertain about what exactly I
was fighting for.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ネイサン
US EN person identifier agrees

だが、それを忠義という理屈でごまかし、
己を無理矢理に納得させていたのだ。
text.official_en:
Loyalty, I told myself. It was never true, but I
forced myself to accept it.

text.official_en: <TH>

text.official_en:
There's no shortage of Aragonian soldiers here.

アラゴの緑騎士の名で彼らが奮い立つ

text.official_en:
If Creek the Green can give them a little hope,
a little inspiration, then that's not a bad thing.

text.official_en:
Though...I might want to keep an eye on them and
ensure they don't charge into battle rashly.

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

text.jp:
森で梨がなっているのを見つけたの。
もちろんみんなで分けたわ。
text.official_en:
I found some pears growing in the forest and cooked
them up nice for everyone.

text.jp:
……気のせいかもしれないけど、
前より街の雰囲気が良くなってきたと思う。
text.official_en:
You know, I think things here are starting to settle
down a little bit.

text.jp:
少し前だと、食料の話題を出したら、
喧嘩になっていたもの。
text.official_en:
It wasn't so long ago that eating food in public would
make you a target.

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

text.jp:
救世主様の勇姿に感銘を受けた連中が
自警団を組んだんです。
text.official_en:
Some of us who admire your bravery are forming
a citizen militia, Promised One.

text.jp:
実は俺も、その一員でして。
亡者どもに一泡吹かせてやりますよ！
text.official_en:
I'm one of the founding members. We'll teach those
risen dead not to mess with Dagsion!

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

text.jp:
最近、訓練を始めたの。
武器の扱いは、まだ慣れないけどね。
text.official_en:
I just started training to fight. I'm still struggling to
get the hang of handling a weapon.

text.jp:
でも、せめて自分の身だけでも、
自分で守れるように頑張らないと。
text.official_en:
But I can't give up. I need to learn to defend myself
and not rely on anyone else to do it for me.

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

text.jp:
自警団だか義勇軍だか知りませんが、
武器を手に取る者が増えたようです。
text.official_en:
More and more people are taking up arms for that
volunteer force, or citizen militia, or whatever.

text.jp:
あまり、無茶なことはしてほしくありませんね。
勇気だけではどうにもならないのですから。
text.official_en:
I hope they don't get too ambitious. Bravery alone
won't cut it against the risen dead.

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

text.jp:
あの、救世主様……
たまにでいいから、僕の夢に出てくれない？
text.official_en:
Um, Promised One? Even if it's just sometimes,
could you show up in my dreams?

text.jp:
死んじゃった友達の声がね、毎晩聞こえるんだ。
痛い、苦しいって……だから、お願い。
text.official_en:
Every night, I dream of my dead friend saying, "It
hurts" and "I'm in pain" and stuff. Can you help?

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

text.jp:
戦死したバルカンや神殿兵の遺品を集めて、
可能な限りご遺族にお返しするようにしています。
text.official_en:
We collect keepsakes from dead vulkans and temple
soldiers to try to get them to their next of kin.

text.jp:
しかし、帝都に残っていたご家族も、
全員すでに亡くなっていることがほとんどです。
text.official_en:
But if their families lived in the capital, there's rarely
anyone left to pass them on to.

text.jp:
誰の手にも渡らない遺品は、放置する他ありません。
心苦しいことです……
text.official_en:
If we can't identify a next of kin, there's not much
we can do with any personal effects. It's a shame...

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

text.jp:
神殿付近の清掃活動を続けています。
祈りに訪れる人々のために。
text.official_en:
We're still cleaning up the spaces around the temples,
for the sake of those who come to pray.

text.jp:
きれいな道のほうが歩きやすいですし、
心も落ち着くでしょうから。
text.official_en:
It's easier to get there if the roads are clear. Helps to
put the mind at ease too.

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

text.jp:
こんな悲惨な世の中だけれど……
それでも人は愛し合い、新しい命を育む。
text.official_en:
This world is full of misery, but people still fall in
love and raise new life.

text.jp:
私もそう……お腹にね……
この子の父親は逃げる途中で亡者に殺されたわ。
text.official_en:
I'm pregnant myself—with the child of a man who
was killed fleeing the risen dead.

text.jp:
だから祈りに来たの。
少しでも、幸せな未来となるように。
text.official_en:
I came here today to pray for a happier future for
the little one.

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

text.jp:
最近流れて来たあいつ……
間違いない、昔俺の畑を荒らした賊だ。
text.official_en:
I'm positive that guy who showed up recently is the
same bandit who once laid waste to my field.

text.jp:
正直追い出してやりたいが、このご時世だしな。
居場所がねえのは奴も同じだ。我慢してやるか。
text.official_en:
I don't like him being here, but where's he gonna go?
Things are so bad all over that I can't hold a grudge.

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

text.jp:
ああ、また奥歯が抜けちまった……
ろくなもん食えてないからかね。
text.official_en:
Another back tooth fell out. Probably because I'm
undernourished.

text.jp:
元々贅沢な暮らしとは縁遠かったが。
近頃はもう、いよいよダメだね。
text.official_en:
It's not like I was living the high life before, but this...
I don't think I'm going to make it.

text.jp:
帝都でもひもじいままなら、
あのまま故郷で死んだ方が良かったよ。
text.official_en:
Why'd I bother coming to Dagsion just to starve?
I could've died at home.

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

text.jp:
ここに避難して来て、少し経ちました。
身一つの僕を迎え入れてくださって感謝しています。
text.official_en:
It's been some time since I took refuge here. I'm still
grateful they took in someone as destitute as me.

text.jp:
幸い、体は動きます。
少しでもできることを探していきたいですね。
text.official_en:
At least I have my health, right? There's got to be
a way for me to do my part, however small.

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

text.jp:
私の祖国、アラゴはギルキルス王の悪政により
随分と荒れてしまいました。
text.official_en:
The misrule of King Gilchris made a mess of my
homeland of Arago.

text.jp:
ですが、あの暗君でさえ自国の民を皆殺しには
しなかったのです。下には下がいるものですね……
text.official_en:
But even he wasn't so callous as to kill every one of
his subjects. There's always someone worse, I guess.

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

text.jp:
親子で逃げてきたのですが、亡者に襲われた際の
傷が癒えず、息子が亡くなりました。
text.official_en:
I fled here with my son, but his wounds from the
risen dead were too severe, and he passed away.

text.jp:
道端で野垂れ死ぬのではなく、
静かな場所で看取ることが出来た……
text.official_en:
At least I was able to bury him someplace nice
instead of a ditch on the side of the road.

text.jp:
それだけでも、幸運だったと
思うべきなのでしょうね。
text.official_en: You have to take what you can get these days.

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

text.jp:
元貴族の婆さんが死んじまったらしい。
ここまで逃げて来たってのに、何でかねえ。
text.official_en:
My grandmother is dead. I thought she'd made it to
safety here, but no.

text.jp:
あ、悪い、悪い。頑張って救おうとしてる
あんたに言う話じゃねえか。忘れてくれや。
text.official_en:
I'm sorry. You don't need to hear this while you're
doing your best to save us. Forget I brought it up.

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

text.jp:
僕は元々漁師だったんですが、
今は自警団にいます。
text.official_en:
I used to be a fisher, but I'm part of the citizen
militia now.

text.jp:
使ってた道具は武器に替えました。
次に漁に出るのは世界が平和になった後です。
text.official_en:
I turned the tools of my trade into weapons. I won't
go fishing again until the world is at peace.

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

text.jp:
この港は、いろんな国と繋がっていて、
たくさんの人と交流してきたって話だよな。
text.official_en:
This port was used by people from many nations,
so all sorts of folks had dealings here.

text.jp:
だったら……ダグザの地がやばいって話を聞いて、
誰か助けに来てくれるんじゃねえかな。
text.official_en:
Do you think when they hear how bad things are in
Dagda, they'll send someone to help us?

text.jp:
救世主様だってちゃんと現れてくださったんだ。
他にもいたっておかしくねえだろ？
text.official_en:
I mean, you showed up when you were needed.
Is it really so strange that others might do the same?

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

text.jp:
私も夫も、かつてアラゴの兵士でした。ある日、
彼は消息を絶ち……愛馬だけが戻ってきました。
text.official_en:
My husband and I were Aragonian soldiers long ago.
One day, only his horse returned from battle.

text.jp:
名誉の死を遂げたのだと思っていたのですが……
信じられます？　戦地で愛人を作っていたんです！
text.official_en:
I used to think he died honorably in combat, but get
this—he found himself a lover on the front lines!

text.jp:
毎日無事を祈っていたのがもう、馬鹿らしくって！
即座に離縁してやりました。
text.official_en:
I felt so stupid after praying every day that he'd come
home safe. Anyway, we're divorced now.

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

text.jp:
昔はこのへんで、結構店が栄えてたんだよな。
だったら、何か落ちてやしねえかな？
text.official_en:
The Dagsion market was once a thriving place. Might
a few of the wares from those days be still around?

text.jp:
商品になりそうなもんだったら、拾って磨いて
売ってやるんだ！　なんとしても儲けを出すぜ！
text.official_en:
If I find something that looks like it'd sell, I pick it
up, polish it, and sell it for a guaranteed profit!

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

text.jp:
自警団の活動のため、私財を寄付致しました。
わたしはもう、貴族でもなんでもありません。
text.official_en:
Rather than remain a noble, I donated my private
wealth to support the citizen militia.

text.jp:
身分を維持するよりも、生き残ることのほうが
よほど大事です。後悔はしていませんよ。
text.official_en:
I regret nothing. Survival is much more important
than prestige.

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

text.jp:
救世主様もここからの
眺めを見に来たんですか？
text.official_en: I see you've also come for the view, Promised One.

text.jp:
そういえば、救世主様は
こういう話を知ってますか？
text.official_en: Do you know what people say about this place?

text.jp:
なんでも、ダグザ神殿の前で恋人と
誓いあった愛は、必ず成就するって。
text.official_en:
Vows sworn before Dagda's temple are supposed to
